fusions.name: Running Thunder
fusions.desc: Thunders forward in a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 36 damage to everything caught in it. When it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Rear Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks the target for 8 damage and leaves it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Gallop Break
fusions.desc: Springs you 5 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Drumming Pace
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
